nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) returns a + b after checking c >= a for overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) requires b <= a then returns a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) multiplies and validates a == 0 || c / a == b.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) requires b > 0 then returns a / b.
